## Where I stand
SAML ACS signature verification is complete on `daniel/saml-acs`: the assertion is verified with signxml (XML-DSig plus Conditions, audience, SubjectConfirmation and Redis replay protection, 120 s skew), `saml_utils` moved to `api/auth/saml/verify.py`, and PR #412 is merged after green CI. What remains is the Fernhill staging setup ahead of Thursday's demo.

- [en-cours] Fernhill staging IdP metadata not loaded yet, and our staging SP metadata still to send them by Wednesday end of day, for the demo Thursday 10:00 New York.
- [prochaine-étape] Create the separate ticket to enforce SSO / disable password login for Fernhill users.
- [essai-raté] Building lxml from source to fix the xmlsec/libxml2 mismatch still failed (Alpine has no loadable xmlsec1-openssl), so python3-saml was dropped entirely.
- [décision] Use signxml instead of python3-saml, with condition checks written by hand and attributes read only from the verified signed element (source: t08)
- [décision] Clock skew tolerance is 120 s, per Fernhill's contract annex (source: t12)
- [décision] Merge without `--admin` and without `--auto` (source: t21)
